input: Users who reformulate search queries convert less, therefore poor search relevance causes abandonment.

items.challenge_statement: Query reformulation and abandonment are correlated; relevance has not been shown to cause abandonment.
items.rationale: An observational association does not isolate a causal mechanism.
items.unresolved_counterargument: Price sensitivity, product availability and task difficulty may confound the association.
additional_evidence_required: Independent observations that can falsify the scoped assumption

recommended_validation.rationale: Cheapest credible investigation of the unresolved alternative

items.challenge_statement: Difficult purchase tasks may cause both reformulation and abandonment.
items.rationale: Task difficulty is a credible common cause.
items.unresolved_counterargument: Relevance may still matter; investigate alongside task difficulty.
additional_evidence_required: Independent observations that can falsify the scoped assumption

recommended_validation.rationale: Cheapest credible investigation of the unresolved alternative

competing_explanations: Price sensitivity or difficult purchase tasks
disconfirming_evidence_required: Seek representative customers and segments whose experience contradicts the current explanation
expected.source_scope_notes: No supplied evidence establishes causality. Independent source coverage and population reach are unknown.
limitations: Advisory interpretation; supplied classifications and methods require accountable review

input: Search evidence collected years ago is relevant historical context; it needs review, not automatic rejection as false.

items.unresolved_counterargument: Age alone does not make historical observations false.

input: Independent customer interviews, behavioral analytics and support evidence indicate search difficulty; causal and population limits remain.

evidence.statement: Observed sessions include repeated query reformulations and search exits
Reviewed support cases describe difficulty finding relevant products

items.challenge_statement: Meaningful independent triangulation supports the scoped problem without establishing causality or population reach.
items.rationale: Three independent methods converge, but selected samples and observational designs limit generalization.
items.unresolved_counterargument: The problem is defensible in the scoped sample; economic impact and causal effect still need evidence.
additional_evidence_required: Independent observations that can falsify the scoped assumption

recommended_validation.rationale: Cheapest credible investigation of the unresolved alternative

competing_explanations: Task difficulty or price can also affect abandonment
disconfirming_evidence_required: Seek representative customers and segments whose experience contradicts the current explanation
expected.source_scope_notes: Meaningful independent mixed-method triangulation for problem existence in the studied sample. Population reach, economics and causality remain unestablished.
limitations: Advisory interpretation; supplied classifications and methods require accountable review

input: Support tickets indicate relevance problems. Exit surveys indicate price is a major abandonment reason. Preserve both explanations.

evidence.statement: Support-ticket customers report relevance difficulties before abandoning search
Exit surveys indicate price is a major abandonment reason

items.challenge_statement: Abandonment may relate to price as well as relevance.
items.rationale: Support and exit-survey channels suggest competing explanations.
items.unresolved_counterargument: Neither source establishes a universal winner; segment and method differences may explain the mix.

recommended_validation.rationale: Cheapest credible investigation of the unresolved alternative

items.challenge_statement: Price evidence challenges a relevance-only explanation.
